Note that the LHS of (2) refers to the maximum average error over an arbitrary set of ℓ attribute-disjoint queries; while this is a weaker bound than the maximum error over all individual queries, it is stronger than MSE. We leave it as an open problem to close this gap and obtain a standard maximum error bound. The main difference between Algorithm 1 and standard MWEM is that in each iteration we sample ℓ attribute-disjoint queries in parallel, rather than a single query; setting ℓ = 1 recovers the standard MWEM algorithm and bound.
